steps.title: Aliquot laminin521 and E8 supplement
steps.instruction: Aliquot laminin521 and E8 supplement into small volumes to avoid repeated freeze‑thaw cycles (Timing: 15 min).

steps.title: Prepare stock solution aliquots
steps.instruction: Make aliquots of all NES derivation, culture and differentiation stock solutions to reduce freeze‑thaw cycles; see Table 2 for storage and working concentrations (Timing: 1 h).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend and filter Poly‑L‑Ornithine in PBS to a final concentration of 100 µg/mL and aliquot.
Resuspend Noggin in PBS at 500 µg/mL and aliquot 20 µL.
Aliquot KnockOut Serum Replacement (KOSR) and non‑essential amino acids in 10 mL volumes.
Resuspend 1 mg of SB431542 in 260 µL DMSO to a final concentration of 10 mM and aliquot.
Resuspend 1 mg of CHIR99021 in 215 µL DMSO to a final concentration of 3.3 µM and aliquot.
Resuspend bFGF in PBS‑BSA 0.15 % and EGF in PBS to a final concentration of 100 ng/µL; aliquot 100 µL each.
Aliquot B27 (500 µL per aliquot) and N2 together with Penicillin‑Streptomycin (5 mL per aliquot).
Optional: Prepare N‑Acetyl‑L‑cysteine (NAC) stock at 612 mM (100 mg/mL) by heating dH₂O to 37 °C for 5 min; store and dilute to working concentrations of 0.5 mM (low) and 2.5 mM (high).

steps.title: Aliquot nucleofection buffer P3
steps.instruction: Aliquot buffer P3 from the Lonza nucleofection kit; P3 is the most efficient buffer for NES cells (Timing: 1 h).

steps.title: Prepare plasmid DNA for nucleofection
steps.instruction: Measure plasmid DNA concentration and dilute to the required amount in a small volume so that the composition of buffer P3 is not altered; test different DNA concentrations to identify the optimal one.

steps.title: Prepare NES growth medium
steps.instruction: Prepare NES growth medium following the standard NES cell growth procedure, avoiding repeated freeze‑thaw cycles of EGF and bFGF aliquots (size of aliquots based on average weekly use). Note that reagents are not toxic and require no special handling; addition of Penicillin‑Streptomycin is optional. Store NES growth or differentiation medium (including NAC‑containing differentiation medium) at +4 °C for a maximum of 1 week.

steps.title: Coat iPS plates with laminin521
steps.instruction: Dilute laminin521 to a working concentration of 5 µg/mL in PBS (Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺‑free or with Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺) and add the volume indicated in Table 1 to each well (Timing: 30 min). Incubate the freshly coated plates at 4 °C for at least 12 h; seal with parafilm for extended storage (>24 h at +4 °C).

steps.title: Coat NES plates with Poly‑L‑Ornithine
steps.instruction: Resuspend Poly‑L‑Ornithine in PBS to 100 µg/mL. Add the volume indicated in Table 1 to each well and incubate for at least 2 h at 37 °C (Timing: 1 day).

steps.title: Coat NES plates with mouse laminin
steps.instruction: Wash Poly‑L‑Ornithine‑coated plates three times with ≥1 mL PBS per 3 cm plate. Dilute mouse laminin to 4 µg/mL in PBS, add the volume indicated in Table 1 to each well, and incubate for at least 12 h at +4 °C (or until needed). Seal plates with parafilm for extended storage (>24 h at +4 °C).
